title: The Choosing the Plain Cup
youtube_title: The Choosing the Plain Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Zola feels shy about choosing the plain cup instead of pretending to want the fancy one. Instead of pretending not to care, Zola tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
